description: Edit an existing advertisement. Only provided fields change. Use is_paused to pause or resume. Set submit_for_review: true to move a ready_for_review ad into review after editing. Changing cpm or budget requires the same currency precision rules as creation. Use dry_run: true to validate without calling the API. Requires confirm: true and TG_ADS_MODE=write.

timezone.description: Offset in seconds from UTC. Required unless use_viewer_timezone is true.

use_viewer_timezone.description: Apply the schedule in the viewer's timezone. Users targeting only.

week_hours_mask.description: Exactly 7 bitmasks, Monday first. Bit 0 is 00:00-01:00, bit 23 is 23:00-00:00. All zeros means no schedule.

name: tg_update_ad
